cases.symptom: The named-Computer proof rejected Boat's real saved tree: folders are kind "dir", not "directory", and two stock systemd names contain literal backslashes.
cases.rule: zstack-review › Tests: qualify provider-shaped fixtures against a real response at least once.

cases.symptom: The saved-tree proof admitted residue beside the selected repositories, extra managed-settings entries and descendants of sanitized file paths.
cases.rule: The saved artifact proof must cover everything sanitation clears, not only the direct private roots.

cases.symptom: Files the Computer build deleted (boot marker, disk epoch) reappeared in the saved artifact because Boat's incremental save kept the older payload.
cases.rule: Sanitize persistent provider disks by truncating in place, never by unlinking, and verify the saved artifact rather than the live cleanup.

cases.symptom: A deletion test released a contended lock after a fixed 75 ms sleep. On a slow runner the worker never saw contention, so main went red.
cases.rule: zstack-review › Tests: hold the contended condition until the code under test observes it; no fixed sleeps.

cases.symptom: actor-confirm and warm-context ran under the exclusive per-owner funding lock, and warm-context synchronized credentials. The lock family used about 80% of Alpha DB time and caused reconnect loops.
cases.rule: zstack-review › Concurrency: read paths take no mutation lock; deadlines anchor at the start of the observation.

cases.symptom: The Alpha fixture login was denied: WorkOS rejects a secret-backed password grant for the desktop client (invalid_client) and accepts it for the web client.
cases.rule: Qualify authentication flows against the real provider configuration before relying on them.
cases.check: pnpm --dir apps/control-plane exec vitest run src/zeros-dev-auth-workos.test.ts

cases.symptom: CodeQL raised two high alerts because tests checked a credential file's mode with stat and then read it by path.
cases.rule: zstack-review › Security: open once and validate the descriptor, in tests too.

cases.symptom: GitHub connect refused Alpha's ten-minute OAuth state because the harness required at most exactly 600,000 ms remaining and Alpha's clock runs about 0.5 s ahead.
cases.rule: zstack-verify › Gotchas: tolerate clock skew and compare against the documented bound.

cases.symptom: The control plane stores repository names in lowercase, while the harness compared GitHub's display casing exactly and reported a configured repository as missing.
cases.rule: Compare GitHub owner and name case-insensitively and numeric IDs exactly.

cases.symptom: workspace create sent the retired cloudComputerBuild field, and the control plane refused it with 409 before admission.
cases.rule: zstack-review › Compatibility: check the current route contract; don't send retired fields.

cases.symptom: A resident-host test flaked in teardown because interactive bash ignores SIGTERM, so stopping could not prove the process group empty under load.
cases.rule: playbooks/ci-red.md: a repeated flake gets a deterministic fix; check teardown before the asserted behavior.

cases.symptom: Named Computers introduced boat-computer:<name>@sha256:<digest> image references. The VM setup helper accepted only boat-template:, so every workspace from a named Computer failed setup_settings_invalid.
cases.rule: zstack-review › Compatibility: when a producer adds a new identifier form, update every consumer's parser in the same change (search for the old prefix).

cases.symptom: The concurrent last-slot warm-context test expected only a capacity 429, but bounded SERIALIZABLE retries can exhaust before the winner commits and correctly return transient contention 503.
cases.rule: playbooks/ci-red.md: control both commit schedules, distinguish observed committed capacity from retry exhaustion, and keep the exact final capacity bound.
cases.check: pnpm --dir apps/control-plane exec vitest run src/cloud-workspaces/agent-boot-executions.integration.test.ts -t 'does not oversubscribe the last context slot'
